Title: Log in with role-based access
User story: As an Administrator, Teacher or Student, I want to log in with my ID and password so that I reach the dashboard for my role.
Acceptance criteria: Valid credentials open the dashboard that matches the user's role | Credentials are verified through the Security / Auth Service, which returns the role | A session is created only after successful verification

Title: Handle invalid credentials and locked accounts
User story: As a user, I want clear messages when login fails so that I know what to do next.
Acceptance criteria: Invalid credentials show an error and ask the user to re-enter | A locked or disabled account is denied and told to contact the administrator | No session is created on failure

Title: Log out securely
User story: As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that nobody else can use my session.
Acceptance criteria: Logout ends the active session and returns to the login page | Pressing Back does not reopen protected pages

Title: Change my password
User story: As a logged-in user, I want to change my password so that I can keep my account secure.
Acceptance criteria: User must enter the current password to set a new one | New password is validated and a confirmation is shown

Title: Restrict pages and data by role
User story: As a Student, I want to see only my own attendance so that my data stays private.
Acceptance criteria: A Student cannot open another student's records, even by typing a URL | A Teacher can access only their assigned classes and subjects | User management pages are available only to the Administrator

Title: Select class, subject and date
User story: As a Teacher, I want to pick a class, subject and date so that I can mark attendance for that session.
Acceptance criteria: Only classes and subjects assigned to the Teacher are listed | A message is shown when no classes are assigned | The student roster loads for the chosen class, subject and date

Title: Mark Present, Absent or Late
User story: As a Teacher, I want to mark each student Present, Absent or Late so that the day's attendance is recorded.
Acceptance criteria: Each student can be set to Present, Absent or Late | Submitting with an unmarked student prompts the Teacher to complete all entries | Teacher can review the marks before submitting

Title: Save attendance records
User story: As a Teacher, I want submitted attendance to be saved so that it is stored permanently.
Acceptance criteria: Submitted attendance is stored in the Attendance Database | A success confirmation is shown to the Teacher | Saving triggers recalculation of the attendance percentage

Title: Prevent duplicate attendance and allow updates
User story: As a Teacher, I want the system to stop duplicate entries and let me correct a record so that data stays accurate.
Acceptance criteria: A second record for the same student, subject and date cannot be created | An authorized Teacher can update the existing record instead | The update is confirmed to the Teacher

Title: Keep entered data when a save fails
User story: As a Teacher, I want my marks kept if saving fails so that I do not have to enter them again.
Acceptance criteria: A failed save shows an error and a retry option | Marks already entered are not lost | No partial records are written

Title: View my attendance as a student
User story: As a Student, I want to view my attendance by subject and date so that I know where I stand.
Acceptance criteria: Records can be filtered by subject and date | The attendance percentage is shown with the records | A message is shown when no records exist

Title: View class attendance as a teacher
User story: As a Teacher, I want to view attendance for my classes so that I can follow my students' attendance.
Acceptance criteria: Teacher can view records by class, subject and date | Only the Teacher's own classes are visible

Title: Search and filter attendance records
User story: As an authorized user, I want to search and filter records so that I can find specific attendance quickly.
Acceptance criteria: Filter by student, subject, class or date | Results update to match the selected filters

Title: Calculate attendance percentage automatically
User story: As a Student or Teacher, I want the system to calculate attendance percentage so that I do not have to do it by hand.
Acceptance criteria: Percentage = classes attended / total classes held, per subject | The rule for counting Late is decided by the team and documented | Shows 0% or N/A when no records exist, and updates after every save

Title: Alert on low attendance
User story: As a Teacher, I want to see students whose attendance is below a threshold so that I can follow them up.
Acceptance criteria: Threshold can be set by an authorized user | Students below the threshold are listed

Title: Generate attendance reports
User story: As a Teacher or Administrator, I want reports by student, class, subject or date range so that I can review attendance.
Acceptance criteria: Report scope can be student, class, subject or date range | Report is compiled through the Report Engine | A message is shown when no data exists for the scope | Report loads within 3 seconds under normal conditions

Title: Export reports
User story: As an authorized user, I want to export a report so that I can share or print it.
Acceptance criteria: Report can be exported in a supported file format (PDF or CSV) | Exported file matches the on-screen report

Title: Manage user accounts
User story: As an Administrator, I want to add, update and deactivate student and teacher accounts so that access stays current.
Acceptance criteria: Administrator can add and update Student and Teacher accounts | A deactivated account cannot log in

Title: Manage classes and subjects
User story: As an Administrator, I want to create classes and subjects and assign teachers so that attendance can be marked. (Pulled into Sprint 1 because marking depends on it.)
Acceptance criteria: Administrator can create and edit classes and subjects | Teachers can be assigned to classes and subjects

Title: Enroll students in classes and subjects
User story: As an Administrator, I want to assign students to classes and subjects so that rosters are correct.
Acceptance criteria: Students can be assigned to classes and subjects | The roster in UC-02 shows the enrolled students

Title: See a role-based dashboard summary
User story: As a user, I want a dashboard with the attendance information relevant to my role so that I see what matters first.
Acceptance criteria: Student sees own attendance summary | Teacher sees summary of assigned classes | Administrator sees system-wide counts

Title: Pages load within 3 seconds
User story: As a user, I want pages and attendance data to load quickly so that I can work without waiting.
Acceptance criteria: Major pages load within 3 seconds under normal conditions | Percentage and report queries use indexed lookups

Title: Back up attendance data regularly
User story: As an Administrator, I want regular backups so that saved attendance is never lost.
Acceptance criteria: Backups run on a set schedule | A backup can be restored in a test

Title: Protect data in transit
User story: As a user, I want my data encrypted while it travels so that others cannot read it.
Acceptance criteria: All pages and API calls use HTTPS | Credentials are never sent over plain HTTP

Title: Consistent, easy-to-use interface
User story: As a user, I want a clear and consistent interface so that I can find major functions easily.
Acceptance criteria: Navigation and layout are consistent across pages | Main tasks can be reached in a few clicks

Title: Work on modern browsers
User story: As a user, I want the system to work in common browsers so that I can use my own device.
Acceptance criteria: Works correctly in current Chrome, Edge and Firefox
